Śrautasūtras
------------------------------------------
It is quite difficult to understand the वेदस् because of the archaic language and the esoteric rites described there, most of which are completely unfamiliar and unknown to us today. However, the six वेदाङ्गस् (subsidiary sciences of the वेदस्) help us to a great extent in unraveling their mystery and even guide us to perform these Vedic rites.
Out of the six वेदाङ्गस्, the last one is called कल्पसूत्रस्. This again has branched off into four fields, the first of which is the श्रौतसूत्रस्.
The श्रौतसूत्रस् are concerned mainly with the details connected with the performance of the वेदिच् सच्रिड़िचेस्. A few of these may be listed as follows:
The yajamāna (sacrificer) and the ṛtviks (priests); अग्न्याधेय (production of fire from the araṇis or wooden pieces for the sacrifice); details of the performance of some sacrifices like Darśapūrṇmāsa, Somayāgas, चातुर्मास्य sacrifices, Sattra-yāgas and so on; अग्निचयन or preparing the platform for the sacrifices with bricks etc.
All the four वेदस् have their respective श्रौतसूत्रस्. They may be listed as follows:
Ṛgveda:Āśvalāyana ŚrautasūtrasŚāṅkhāyana Śrautasūtras Śukla Yajurveda:Kātyāyana Śrautasūtras Kṛṣṇa Yajurveda:Āpastamba ŚrautasūtrasBaudhāyana ŚrautasūtrasBharadvāja ŚrautasūtrasMānava ŚrautasūtrasVaikhānasa Śrautasūtras Sāmaveda:Ārṣeya Kalpasūtras (or Maśaka Kalpasūtras) containing the Śrautasūtra part also.Drāhyayaṇa ŚrautasūtrasJaiminīya ŚrautasūtrasLāṭyāyana Śrautasūtras Atharvaveda:Vaitāna Śrautasūtras Without the help of these Śrauta-sūtras, it would not have been possible to perform the various वेदिच् सच्रिड़िचेस्.
